excerpt: Meesho is an Indian e-commerce marketplace for low-priced products that does not charge sellers commission. Founded in 2015, listed on NSE and BSE since December 2025.
content:
Meesho is an Indian online marketplace focused on low-priced, everyday products such as clothing, home goods and accessories, sold by small businesses. Inc42 reported in July 2026 that Meesho does not charge sellers a commission on each order; it earns from logistics and fulfilment (including its own logistics arm, Valmo), cost-per-click seller advertising and other seller services. The same report said it works with more than 9.6 lakh sellers and has more than 264 million annual transacting users, with FY26 revenue from operations of Rs 12,626 crore.

TechCrunch reported in 2018 that Meesho was founded in 2015 by Vidit Aatrey, its CEO, and Sanjeev Barnwal, both IIT Delhi graduates, and that it graduated from Y Combinator in 2016. It began as a way for resellers to share product catalogues with friends and family over WhatsApp, before becoming a marketplace in its own right.

Meesho went public in December 2025. Entrackr reported that the shares listed on 10 December 2025 at Rs 162.5 on the NSE, 46% above the Rs 111 issue price. The Rs 5,421 crore IPO combined a Rs 4,250 crore fresh issue with a Rs 1,171 crore offer for sale.

For shoppers the app is free and each product shows its own price. Sellers should read Meesho's current seller terms on its supplier site before listing. This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting. We have not tested the product for this page, and nothing here is paid placement.
